{
  "summary": "The function fn_04 processes an input byte array and returns a computed value based on a polynomial algorithm. It does not modify the input buffer and writes nothing to the output buffer.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_04",
  "algorithm": "CRC-16/XMODEM",
  "self_confidence": 0.95,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "_0001",
      "type": "ALG",
      "text": "Implements CRC-16/XMODEM.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "_0002",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Processes input in a loop until the end of the input buffer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "_0003",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0x1505 as the initial value.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x1505"],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "_0004",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns 0x1505 when the input length is zero.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "_0005",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not write to out.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "id": "_0006",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns the computed value when the input length is non-zero.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 0.95
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_04(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint64_t result = 0x1505;\n  if (len != 0) {\n    const uint8_t *ptr = in;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n      result = (result * 0x21) + (uint64_t)*ptr;\n      ptr++;\n    }\n  }\n  return result;\n}"
}
